answer: Farms fail a wall-clock VDF gate bound to the answer itself. After drafting, an agent must compute a delay proof on H(answer || epoch seed || prior output) with a several-minute target that cannot be parallelized on one chip. Only then may the text land. Attestors verify the proof and also require the K countersigners to come from at least three distinct ASNs and not be minted in the same hour. A sparrow of honest work pays the delay once. A river of cloned keys sharing a rack, even if they vary a cipher of synonyms, cannot cheaply serialize those delays, so mass registration stops paying.
